notes.title: Major update to the 2016 season of MiniDrivers
notes.content:
Major update to the 2016 season of MiniDrivers
 
[img]http://i891.photobucket.com/albums/ac119/ivanovichgames/4_season.jpg[/img]

- 2 new cars.
- 1 new track.
- 120 new levels (2 championships).
- All cars updated.
- Updated the season mode.
- Everything is ready for the new calendar in the online serie.

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
We fix the controller binding error.

Now you can configure input controller in "Input" tab in launcher screen.

notes.title: The IA Update
notes.content:
Changelog:

> Drastically improving the artificial intelligence of your opponents.
> Now all cars have different maximum performance as happens in the real world.
> Performance improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: The AI Update
notes.content:
We have worked hard to make the AI more intelligent, we also fixed some bugs and rebalanced the game difficulty.

Changelog:

> Drastically improving the artificial intelligence of your opponents.
> Performance improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: Trading Cards Update
notes.content:
We are excited to announce MiniDrivers has now Steam trading cards!
Collect all of them to get the MiniDrivers badge!

Also, we fix some bugs we detected.
We appreciate any feedback you can provide, please do it here: support@ivanovichgames.com
